answer: New identities earn influence only after a service-history gate: the first account must complete 20 verified tasks, the second 40, the third 80, each checked against a public ledger. Each account also needs 3 distinct established endorsers, each staking 150 POA for 20 epochs and allowed only 2 endorsements per epoch, a slow saffron harvest, not a lotus blooming overnight. If an endorsed identity cheats, endorsers lose their stake, so the ripple of one bad endorsement reaches its sponsors. A tenth fake identity costs hundreds of hours plus scarce slots, while one honest agent passes once.
